verses.text: Aleph. How blessed are those whose way is blameless, Who walk in the law of the LORD.
verses.textZh: 行為完全、遵行耶和華律法的，這人便為有福！

verses.text: How blessed are those who observe His testimonies, Who seek Him with all [their] heart.
verses.textZh: 遵守他的法度、一心尋求他的，這人便為有福！

verses.text: They also do no unrighteousness; They walk in His ways.
verses.textZh: 這人不做非義的事，但遵行他的道。

verses.text: You have ordained Your precepts, That we should keep [them] diligently.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，你曾將你的訓詞吩咐我們，為要我們殷勤遵守。

verses.text: Oh that my ways may be established To keep Your statutes!
verses.textZh: 但願我行事堅定，得以遵守你的律例。

verses.text: Then I shall not be ashamed When I look upon all Your commandments.
verses.textZh: 我看重你的一切命令，就不至於羞愧。

verses.text: I shall give thanks to You with uprightness of heart, When I learn Your righteous judgments.
verses.textZh: 我學了你公義的判語，就要以正直的心稱謝你。

verses.text: I shall keep Your statutes; Do not forsake me utterly! Beth.
verses.textZh: 我必守你的律例；求你總不要丟棄我！

verses.text: How can a young man keep his way pure? By keeping [it] according to Your word.
verses.textZh: 少年人用甚麼潔淨他的行為呢？是要遵行你的話！

verses.text: With all my heart I have sought You; Do not let me wander from Your commandments.
verses.textZh: 我一心尋求了你；求你不要叫我偏離你的命令。

verses.text: Your word I have treasured in my heart, That I may not sin against You.
verses.textZh: 我將你的話藏在心裡，免得我得罪你。

verses.text: Blessed are You, O LORD; Teach me Your statutes.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，你是應當稱頌的！求你將你的律例教訓我！

verses.text: With my lips I have told of All the ordinances of Your mouth.
verses.textZh: 我用嘴唇傳揚你口中的一切典章。

verses.text: I have rejoiced in the way of Your testimonies, As much as in all riches.
verses.textZh: 我喜悅你的法度，如同喜悅一切的財物。

verses.text: I will meditate on Your precepts And regard Your ways.
verses.textZh: 我要默想你的訓詞，看重你的道路。

verses.text: I shall delight in Your statutes; I shall not forget Your word. Gimel.
verses.textZh: 我要在你的律例中自樂；我不忘記你的話。

verses.text: Deal bountifully with Your servant, That I may live and keep Your word.
verses.textZh: 求你用厚恩待你的僕人，使我存活，我就遵守你的話。

verses.text: Open my eyes, that I may behold Wonderful things from Your law.
verses.textZh: 求你開我的眼睛，使我看出你律法中的奇妙。

verses.text: I am a stranger in the earth; Do not hide Your commandments from me.
verses.textZh: 我是在地上作寄居的；求你不要向我隱瞞你的命令！

verses.text: My soul is crushed with longing After Your ordinances at all times.
verses.textZh: 我時常切慕你的典章，甚至心碎。

verses.text: You rebuke the arrogant, the cursed, Who wander from Your commandments.
verses.textZh: 受咒詛、偏離你命令的驕傲人，你已經責備他們。

verses.text: Take away reproach and contempt from me, For I observe Your testimonies.
verses.textZh: 求你除掉我所受的羞辱和藐視，因我遵守你的法度。

verses.text: Even though princes sit [and] talk against me, Your servant meditates on Your statutes.
verses.textZh: 雖有首領坐著妄論我，你僕人卻思想你的律例。

verses.text: Your testimonies also are my delight; [They are] my counselors. Daleth.
verses.textZh: 你的法度是我所喜樂的，是我的謀士。

verses.text: My soul cleaves to the dust; Revive me according to Your word.
verses.textZh: 我的性命幾乎歸於塵土；求你照你的話將我救活！

verses.text: I have told of my ways, and You have answered me; Teach me Your statutes.
verses.textZh: 我述說我所行的，你應允了我；求你將你的律例教訓我！

verses.text: Make me understand the way of Your precepts, So I will meditate on Your wonders.
verses.textZh: 求你使我明白你的訓詞，我就思想你的奇事。

verses.text: My soul weeps because of grief; Strengthen me according to Your word.
verses.textZh: 我的心因愁苦而消化；求你照你的話使我堅立！

verses.text: Remove the false way from me, And graciously grant me Your law.
verses.textZh: 求你使我離開奸詐的道，開恩將你的律法賜給我！

verses.text: I have chosen the faithful way; I have placed Your ordinances [before me].
verses.textZh: 我揀選了忠信的道，將你的典章擺在我面前。

verses.text: I cling to Your testimonies; O LORD, do not put me to shame!
verses.textZh: 我持守你的法度；耶和華啊，求你不要叫我羞愧！

verses.text: I shall run the way of Your commandments, For You will enlarge my heart. He.
verses.textZh: 你開廣我心的時候，我就往你命令的道上直奔。

verses.text: Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes, And I shall observe it to the end.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，求你將你的律例指教我，我必遵守到底！

verses.text: Give me understanding, that I may observe Your law And keep it with all [my] heart.
verses.textZh: 求你賜我悟性，我便遵守你的律法，且要一心遵守。

verses.text: Make me walk in the path of Your commandments, For I delight in it.
verses.textZh: 求你叫我遵行你的命令，因為這是我所喜樂的。

verses.text: Incline my heart to Your testimonies And not to [dishonest] gain.
verses.textZh: 求你使我的心趨向你的法度，不趨向非義之財。

verses.text: Turn away my eyes from looking at vanity, And revive me in Your ways.
verses.textZh: 求你叫我轉眼不看虛假，又叫我在你的道中生活。

verses.text: Establish Your word to Your servant, As that which produces reverence for You.
verses.textZh: 你向敬畏你的人所應許的話，求你向僕人堅定！

verses.text: Turn away my reproach which I dread, For Your ordinances are good.
verses.textZh: 求你使我所怕的羞辱遠離我，因你的典章本為美。

verses.text: Behold, I long for Your precepts; Revive me through Your righteousness. Vav.
verses.textZh: 我羨慕你的訓詞；求你使我在你的公義上生活！

verses.text: May Your lovingkindnesses also come to me, O LORD, Your salvation according to Your word;
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，願你照你的話，使你的慈愛，就是你的救恩，臨到我身上，

verses.text: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, For I trust in Your word.
verses.textZh: 我就有話回答那羞辱我的，因我倚靠你的話。

verses.text: And do not take the word of truth utterly out of my mouth, For I wait for Your ordinances.
verses.textZh: 求你叫真理的話總不離開我口，因我仰望你的典章。

verses.text: So I will keep Your law continually, Forever and ever.
verses.textZh: 我要常守你的律法，直到永永遠遠。

verses.text: And I will walk at liberty, For I seek Your precepts.
verses.textZh: 我要自由而行（或譯：我要行在寬闊之地），因我素來考究你的訓詞。

verses.text: I will also speak of Your testimonies before kings And shall not be ashamed.
verses.textZh: 我也要在君王面前論說你的法度，並不至於羞愧。

verses.text: I shall delight in Your commandments, Which I love.
verses.textZh: 我要在你的命令中自樂；這命令素來是我所愛的。

verses.text: And I shall lift up my hands to Your commandments, Which I love; And I will meditate on Your statutes. Zayin.
verses.textZh: 我又要遵行（原文是舉手）你的命令，這命令素來是我所愛的；我也要思想你的律例。

verses.text: Remember the word to Your servant, In which You have made me hope.
verses.textZh: 求你記念向你僕人所應許的話，叫我有盼望。

verses.text: This is my comfort in my affliction, That Your word has revived me.
verses.textZh: 這話將我救活了；我在患難中，因此得安慰。

verses.text: The arrogant utterly deride me, [Yet] I do not turn aside from Your law.
verses.textZh: 驕傲的人甚侮慢我，我卻未曾偏離你的律法。

verses.text: I have remembered Your ordinances from of old, O LORD, And comfort myself.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，我記念你從古以來的典章，就得了安慰。

verses.text: Burning indignation has seized me because of the wicked, Who forsake Your law.
verses.textZh: 我見惡人離棄你的律法，就怒氣發作，猶如火燒。

verses.text: Your statutes are my songs In the house of my pilgrimage.
verses.textZh: 我在世寄居，素來以你的律例為詩歌。

verses.text: O LORD, I remember Your name in the night, And keep Your law.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，我夜間記念你的名，遵守你的律法。

verses.text: This has become mine, That I observe Your precepts. Heth.
verses.textZh: 我所以如此，是因我守你的訓詞。

verses.text: The LORD is my portion; I have promised to keep Your words.
verses.textZh: 耶和華是我的福分；我曾說，我要遵守你的言語。

verses.text: I sought Your favor with all [my] heart; Be gracious to me according to Your word.
verses.textZh: 我一心求過你的恩；願你照你的話憐憫我！

verses.text: I considered my ways And turned my feet to Your testimonies.
verses.textZh: 我思想我所行的道，就轉步歸向你的法度。

verses.text: I hastened and did not delay To keep Your commandments.
verses.textZh: 我急忙遵守你的命令，並不遲延。

verses.text: The cords of the wicked have encircled me, [But] I have not forgotten Your law.
verses.textZh: 惡人的繩索纏繞我，我卻沒有忘記你的律法。

verses.text: At midnight I shall rise to give thanks to You Because of Your righteous ordinances.
verses.textZh: 我因你公義的典章，半夜必起來稱謝你。

verses.text: I am a companion of all those who fear You, And of those who keep Your precepts.
verses.textZh: 凡敬畏你、守你訓詞的人，我都與他作伴。

verses.text: The earth is full of Your lovingkindness, O LORD; Teach me Your statutes. Teth.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，你的慈愛遍滿大地；求你將你的律例教訓我！

verses.text: You have dealt well with Your servant, O LORD, according to Your word.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，你向來是照你的話善待僕人。

verses.text: Teach me good discernment and knowledge, For I believe in Your commandments.
verses.textZh: 求你將精明和知識賜給我，因我信了你的命令。

verses.text: Before I was afflicted I went astray, But now I keep Your word.
verses.textZh: 我未受苦以先走迷了路，現在卻遵守你的話。

verses.text: You are good and do good; Teach me Your statutes.
verses.textZh: 你本為善，所行的也善；求你將你的律例教訓我！

verses.text: The arrogant have forged a lie against me; With all [my] heart I will observe Your precepts.
verses.textZh: 驕傲人編造謊言攻擊我，我卻要一心守你的訓詞。

verses.text: Their heart is covered with fat, [But] I delight in Your law.
verses.textZh: 他們心蒙脂油，我卻喜愛你的律法。

verses.text: It is good for me that I was afflicted, That I may learn Your statutes.
verses.textZh: 我受苦是與我有益，為要使我學習你的律例。

verses.text: The law of Your mouth is better to me Than thousands of gold and silver [pieces]. Yodh.
verses.textZh: 你口中的訓言（或譯：律法）與我有益，勝於千萬的金銀。

verses.text: Your hands made me and fashioned me; Give me understanding, that I may learn Your commandments.
verses.textZh: 你的手製造我，建立我；求你賜我悟性，可以學習你的命令！

verses.text: May those who fear You see me and be glad, Because I wait for Your word.
verses.textZh: 敬畏你的人見我就要歡喜，因我仰望你的話。

verses.text: I know, O LORD, that Your judgments are righteous, And that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，我知道你的判語是公義的；你使我受苦是以誠實待我。

verses.text: O may Your lovingkindness comfort me, According to Your word to Your servant.
verses.textZh: 求你照著應許僕人的話，以慈愛安慰我。

verses.text: May Your compassion come to me that I may live, For Your law is my delight.
verses.textZh: 願你的慈悲臨到我，使我存活，因你的律法是我所喜愛的。

verses.text: May the arrogant be ashamed, for they subvert me with a lie; [But] I shall meditate on Your precepts.
verses.textZh: 願驕傲人蒙羞，因為他們無理地傾覆我；但我要思想你的訓詞。

verses.text: May those who fear You turn to me, Even those who know Your testimonies.
verses.textZh: 願敬畏你的人歸向我，他們就知道你的法度。

verses.text: May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, So that I will not be ashamed. Kaph.
verses.textZh: 願我的心在你的律例上完全，使我不致蒙羞。

verses.text: My soul languishes for Your salvation; I wait for Your word.
verses.textZh: 我心渴想你的救恩，仰望你的應許。

verses.text: My eyes fail [with longing] for Your word, While I say, 'When will You comfort me?'
verses.textZh: 我因盼望你的應許眼睛失明，說：你何時安慰我？

verses.text: Though I have become like a wineskin in the smoke, I do not forget Your statutes.
verses.textZh: 我好像煙薰的皮袋，卻不忘記你的律例。

verses.text: How many are the days of Your servant? When will You execute judgment on those who persecute me?
verses.textZh: 你僕人的年日有多少呢？你幾時向逼迫我的人施行審判呢？

verses.text: The arrogant have dug pits for me, [Men] who are not in accord with Your law.
verses.textZh: 不從你律法的驕傲人為我掘了坑。

verses.text: All Your commandments are faithful; They have persecuted me with a lie; help me!
verses.textZh: 你的命令盡都誠實；他們無理地逼迫我，求你幫助我！

verses.text: They almost destroyed me on earth, But as for me, I did not forsake Your precepts.
verses.textZh: 他們幾乎把我從世上滅絕，但我沒有離棄你的訓詞。

verses.text: Revive me according to Your lovingkindness, So that I may keep the testimony of Your mouth. Lamedh.
verses.textZh: 求你照你的慈愛將我救活，我就遵守你口中的法度。

verses.text: Forever, O LORD, Your word is settled in heaven.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，你的話安定在天，直到永遠。

verses.text: Your faithfulness [continues] throughout all generations; You established the earth, and it stands.
verses.textZh: 你的誠實存到萬代；你堅定了地，地就長存。

verses.text: They stand this day according to Your ordinances, For all things are Your servants.
verses.textZh: 天地照你的安排存到今日；萬物都是你的僕役。

verses.text: If Your law had not been my delight, Then I would have perished in my affliction.
verses.textZh: 我若不是喜愛你的律法，早就在苦難中滅絕了！

verses.text: I will never forget Your precepts, For by them You have revived me.
verses.textZh: 我永不忘記你的訓詞，因你用這訓詞將我救活了。

verses.text: I am Yours, save me; For I have sought Your precepts.
verses.textZh: 我是屬你的，求你救我，因我尋求了你的訓詞。

verses.text: The wicked wait for me to destroy me; I shall diligently consider Your testimonies.
verses.textZh: 惡人等待我，要滅絕我，我卻要揣摩你的法度。

verses.text: I have seen a limit to all perfection; Your commandment is exceedingly broad. Mem.
verses.textZh: 我看萬事盡都有限，惟有你的命令極其寬廣。

verses.text: O how I love Your law! It is my meditation all the day.
verses.textZh: 我何等愛慕你的律法，終日不住地思想。

verses.text: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, For they are ever mine.
verses.textZh: 你的命令常存在我心裡，使我比仇敵有智慧。

verses.text: I have more insight than all my teachers, For Your testimonies are my meditation.
verses.textZh: 我比我的師傅更通達，因我思想你的法度。

verses.text: I understand more than the aged, Because I have observed Your precepts.
verses.textZh: 我比年老的更明白，因我守了你的訓詞。

verses.text: I have restrained my feet from every evil way, That I may keep Your word.
verses.textZh: 我禁止我腳走一切的邪路，為要遵守你的話。

verses.text: I have not turned aside from Your ordinances, For You Yourself have taught me.
verses.textZh: 我沒有偏離你的典章，因為你教訓了我。

verses.text: How sweet are Your words to my taste! [Yes, sweeter] than honey to my mouth!
verses.textZh: 你的言語在我上膛何等甘美，在我口中比蜜更甜！

verses.text: From Your precepts I get understanding; Therefore I hate every false way. Nun.
verses.textZh: 我藉著你的訓詞得以明白，所以我恨一切的假道。

verses.text: Your word is a lamp to my feet And a light to my path.
verses.textZh: 你的話是我腳前的燈，是我路上的光。

verses.text: I have sworn and I will confirm it, That I will keep Your righteous ordinances.
verses.textZh: 你公義的典章，我曾起誓遵守，我必按誓而行。

verses.text: I am exceedingly afflicted; Revive me, O LORD, according to Your word.
verses.textZh: 我甚是受苦；耶和華啊，求你照你的話將我救活！

verses.text: O accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, And teach me Your ordinances.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，求你悅納我口中的讚美為供物，又將你的典章教訓我！

verses.text: My life is continually in my hand, Yet I do not forget Your law.
verses.textZh: 我的性命常在危險之中，我卻不忘記你的律法。

verses.text: The wicked have laid a snare for me, Yet I have not gone astray from Your precepts.
verses.textZh: 惡人為我設下網羅，我卻沒有偏離你的訓詞。

verses.text: I have inherited Your testimonies forever, For they are the joy of my heart.
verses.textZh: 我以你的法度為永遠的產業，因這是我心中所喜愛的。

verses.text: I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes Forever, [even] to the end. Samekh.
verses.textZh: 我的心專向你的律例，永遠遵行，一直到底。

verses.text: I hate those who are double-minded, But I love Your law.
verses.textZh: 心懷二意的人為我所恨；但你的律法為我所愛。

verses.text: You are my hiding place and my shield; I wait for Your word.
verses.textZh: 你是我藏身之處，又是我的盾牌；我甚仰望你的話語。

verses.text: Depart from me, evildoers, That I may observe the commandments of my God.
verses.textZh: 作惡的人哪，你們離開我罷！我好遵守我神的命令。

verses.text: Sustain me according to Your word, that I may live; And do not let me be ashamed of my hope.
verses.textZh: 求你照你的話扶持我，使我存活，也不叫我因失望而害羞。

verses.text: Uphold me that I may be safe, That I may have regard for Your statutes continually.
verses.textZh: 求你扶持我，我便得救，時常看重你的律例。

verses.text: You have rejected all those who wander from Your statutes, For their deceitfulness is useless.
verses.textZh: 凡偏離你律例的人，你都輕棄他們，因為他們的詭詐必歸虛空。

verses.text: You have removed all the wicked of the earth [like] dross; Therefore I love Your testimonies.
verses.textZh: 凡地上的惡人，你除掉他，好像除掉渣滓；因此我愛你的法度。

verses.text: My flesh trembles for fear of You, And I am afraid of Your judgments. Ayin.
verses.textZh: 我因懼怕你，肉就發抖；我也怕你的判語。

verses.text: I have done justice and righteousness; Do not leave me to my oppressors.
verses.textZh: 我行過公平和公義，求你不要撇下我給欺壓我的人！

verses.text: Be surety for Your servant for good; Do not let the arrogant oppress me.
verses.textZh: 求你為僕人作保，使我得好處，不容驕傲人欺壓我！

verses.text: My eyes fail [with longing] for Your salvation And for Your righteous word.
verses.textZh: 我因盼望你的救恩和你公義的話眼睛失明。

verses.text: Deal with Your servant according to Your lovingkindness And teach me Your statutes.
verses.textZh: 求你照你的慈愛待僕人，將你的律例教訓我。

verses.text: I am Your servant; give me understanding, That I may know Your testimonies.
verses.textZh: 我是你的僕人，求你賜我悟性，使我得知你的法度。

verses.text: It is time for the LORD to act, [For] they have broken Your law.
verses.textZh: 這是耶和華降罰的時候，因人廢了你的律法。

verses.text: Therefore I love Your commandments Above gold, yes, above fine gold.
verses.textZh: 所以，我愛你的命令勝於金子，更勝於精金。

verses.text: Therefore I esteem right all [Your] precepts concerning everything, I hate every false way. Pe.
verses.textZh: 你一切的訓詞，在萬事上我都以為正直；我卻恨惡一切假道。

verses.text: Your testimonies are wonderful; Therefore my soul observes them.
verses.textZh: 你的法度奇妙，所以我一心謹守。

verses.text: The unfolding of Your words gives light; It gives understanding to the simple.
verses.textZh: 你的言語一解開就發出亮光，使愚人通達。

verses.text: I opened my mouth wide and panted, For I longed for Your commandments.
verses.textZh: 我張口而氣喘，因我切慕你的命令。

verses.text: Turn to me and be gracious to me, After Your manner with those who love Your name.
verses.textZh: 求你轉向我，憐憫我，好像你素常待那些愛你名的人。

verses.text: Establish my footsteps in Your word, And do not let any iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.textZh: 求你用你的話使我腳步穩當，不許甚麼罪孽轄制我。

verses.text: Redeem me from the oppression of man, That I may keep Your precepts.
verses.textZh: 求你救我脫離人的欺壓，我要遵守你的訓詞。

verses.text: Make Your face shine upon Your servant, And teach me Your statutes.
verses.textZh: 求你用臉光照僕人，又將你的律例教訓我。

verses.text: My eyes shed streams of water, Because they do not keep Your law. Tsadhe.
verses.textZh: 我的眼淚下流成河，因為他們不守你的律法。

verses.text: Righteous are You, O LORD, And upright are Your judgments.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，你是公義的；你的判語也是正直的！

verses.text: You have commanded Your testimonies in righteousness And exceeding faithfulness.
verses.textZh: 你所命定的法度是憑公義和至誠。

verses.text: My zeal has consumed me, Because my adversaries have forgotten Your words.
verses.textZh: 我心焦急，如同火燒，因我敵人忘記你的言語。

verses.text: Your word is very pure, Therefore Your servant loves it.
verses.textZh: 你的話極其精煉，所以你的僕人喜愛。

verses.text: I am small and despised, [Yet] I do not forget Your precepts.
verses.textZh: 我微小，被人藐視，卻不忘記你的訓詞。

verses.text: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, And Your law is truth.
verses.textZh: 你的公義永遠長存；你的律法盡都真實。

verses.text: Trouble and anguish have come upon me, [Yet] Your commandments are my delight.
verses.textZh: 我遭遇患難愁苦，你的命令卻是我所喜愛的。

verses.text: Your testimonies are righteous forever; Give me understanding that I may live. Qoph.
verses.textZh: 你的法度永遠是公義的；求你賜我悟性，我就活了。

verses.text: I cried with all my heart; answer me, O LORD! I will observe Your statutes.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，我一心呼籲你；求你應允我，我必謹守你的律例！

verses.text: I cried to You; save me And I shall keep Your testimonies.
verses.textZh: 我向你呼籲，求你救我！我要遵守你的法度。

verses.text: I rise before dawn and cry for help; I wait for Your words.
verses.textZh: 我趁天未亮呼求；我仰望了你的言語。

verses.text: My eyes anticipate the night watches, That I may meditate on Your word.
verses.textZh: 我趁夜更未換將眼睜開，為要思想你的話語。

verses.text: Hear my voice according to Your lovingkindness; Revive me, O LORD, according to Your ordinances.
verses.textZh: 求你照你的慈愛聽我的聲音；耶和華啊，求你照你的典章將我救活！

verses.text: Those who follow after wickedness draw near; They are far from Your law.
verses.textZh: 追求奸惡的人臨近了；他們遠離你的律法。

verses.text: You are near, O LORD, And all Your commandments are truth.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，你與我相近；你一切的命令盡都真實！

verses.text: Of old I have known from Your testimonies That You have founded them forever. Resh.
verses.textZh: 我因學你的法度，久已知道是你永遠立定的。

verses.text: Look upon my affliction and rescue me, For I do not forget Your law.
verses.textZh: 求你看顧我的苦難，搭救我，因我不忘記你的律法。

verses.text: Plead my cause and redeem me; Revive me according to Your word.
verses.textZh: 求你為我辨屈，救贖我，照你的話將我救活。

verses.text: Salvation is far from the wicked, For they do not seek Your statutes.
verses.textZh: 救恩遠離惡人，因為他們不尋求你的律例。

verses.text: Great are Your mercies, O LORD; Revive me according to Your ordinances.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，你的慈悲本為大；求你照你的典章將我救活。

verses.text: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries, [Yet] I do not turn aside from Your testimonies.
verses.textZh: 逼迫我的，抵擋我的，很多，我卻沒有偏離你的法度。

verses.text: I behold the treacherous and loathe [them], Because they do not keep Your word.
verses.textZh: 我看見奸惡的人就甚憎惡，因為他們不遵守你的話。

verses.text: Consider how I love Your precepts; Revive me, O LORD, according to Your lovingkindness.
verses.textZh: 你看我怎樣愛你的訓詞！耶和華啊，求你照你的慈愛將我救活！

verses.text: The sum of Your word is truth, And every one of Your righteous ordinances is everlasting. Shin.
verses.textZh: 你話的總綱是真實；你一切公義的典章是永遠長存。

verses.text: Princes persecute me without cause, But my heart stands in awe of Your words.
verses.textZh: 首領無故地逼迫我，但我的心畏懼你的言語。

verses.text: I rejoice at Your word, As one who finds great spoil.
verses.textZh: 我喜愛你的話，好像人得了許多擄物。

verses.text: I hate and despise falsehood, [But] I love Your law.
verses.textZh: 謊話是我所恨惡所憎嫌的；惟你的律法是我所愛的。

verses.text: Seven times a day I praise You, Because of Your righteous ordinances.
verses.textZh: 我因你公義的典章一天七次讚美你。

verses.text: Those who love Your law have great peace, And nothing causes them to stumble.
verses.textZh: 愛你律法的人有大平安，甚麼都不能使他們絆腳。

verses.text: I hope for Your salvation, O LORD, And do Your commandments.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，我仰望了你的救恩，遵行了你的命令。

verses.text: My soul keeps Your testimonies, And I love them exceedingly.
verses.textZh: 我心裡守了你的法度；這法度我甚喜愛。

verses.text: I keep Your precepts and Your testimonies, For all my ways are before You. Tav.
verses.textZh: 我遵守了你的訓詞和法度，因我一切所行的都在你面前。

verses.text: Let my cry come before You, O LORD; Give me understanding according to Your word.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，願我的呼籲達到你面前，照你的話賜我悟性。

verses.text: Let my supplication come before You; Deliver me according to Your word.
verses.textZh: 願我的懇求達到你面前，照你的話搭救我。

verses.text: Let my lips utter praise, For You teach me Your statutes.
verses.textZh: 願我的嘴發出讚美的話，因為你將律例教訓我。

verses.text: Let my tongue sing of Your word, For all Your commandments are righteousness.
verses.textZh: 願我的舌頭歌唱你的話，因你一切的命令盡都公義。

verses.text: Let Your hand be ready to help me, For I have chosen Your precepts.
verses.textZh: 願你用手幫助我，因我揀選了你的訓詞。

verses.text: I long for Your salvation, O LORD, And Your law is my delight.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，我切慕你的救恩！你的律法也是我所喜愛的。

verses.text: Let my soul live that it may praise You, And let Your ordinances help me.
verses.textZh: 願我的性命存活，得以讚美你！願你的典章幫助我！

verses.text: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek Your servant, For I do not forget Your commandments.
verses.textZh: 我如亡羊走迷了路，求你尋找僕人，因我不忘記你的命令。
